text:
jana: heads-up, after today's v2 default flip a handful of tenants show repeated fallbacks that last ~10-20s, then back to v2. console spam and quota alerts fired for three customers.
ryan: were these clients missing the `X-Client-Version` header or timing out during handshake?
ingrid: mostly handshake_timeout and a few where our sticky-token mapping failed. looks correlated with long prefix-seq len.
telemetry: we currently tag `route.version` and `route.selected` but not why we fell back. proposing new tags: `route.fallback=true`, `route.fallback_reason=handshake_timeout|missing_header|seqlen_mismatch`, `route.fallback_cohort=canary-2025-07`.
jana: love that. also want a TTL on console notifications per tenant so we don't keep alerting for transient reverts. maybe hint_expires_at in tenant UI.
console-ui: agreed. we can add `hint_expires_at` and collapse repeated hints into one with a small donut heatmap of fallback drivers. UX question: do we want to show raw counts or P95 of fallback burst length?
ryan: P95 burst length + distinct tokens affected gives the best signal. raw counts are noisy.
ingrid: implementation note: routing-proxy keeps ephemeral fallback markers keyed by token hash for 15m. can emit `fallback_ttl_s` when proxy routes to v1.
telemetry: for aggregation we suggest these fields in trace/span attrs:```json
{
  "route.policy":"prefer-v2",
  "route.selected":"v1",
  "route.fallback":"true",
  "route.fallback_reason":"handshake_timeout",
  "route.fallback_ttl_s":"900",
  "route.fallback_cohort":"canary-2025-07",
  "telemetry.sample_rate":"0.05"
}
```
qa: to avoid billing shocks, can we mark fallback requests with `billing.exempt=true` for 1h after a flip and then metric it separately?
ryan: yes but need legal/finance signoff. interim: exclude from quota-alerting by tagging `alert.exempt=transient_fallback` and update alert rules.
console-ui: we'll add a rollout dashboard card: "Fallback heatmap" (per-tenant, per-reason) + small table column `alert_exempt_until`. will show tooltip: "counts from transient fallbacks suppressed until <time>".
jana: ops: add a quarantine script to temporarily deprioritize tenants that cause repeated failovers > thrash threshold within 10m. prevents cascading.
ingrid: want to avoid hard quarantines; prefer soft-throttle and sticky back to v1 with a cool-down label. `route.cooldown=true` + `route.cooldown_until` emitted.
telemetry: aggregator change: if `route.fallback==true` and `route.fallback_cohort==canary-2025-07` then roll to "transient" bucket and reduce alert weight by 0.9 for 1h. also store sampled debug payloads to s3://redwood-debug/fallbacks/ with 7d retention.
console-ui: will prototype the hint + heatmap in staging by EOD. API for hint will return `{"hint":"transient fallback due to handshake timeout","hint_expires_at":"2025-07-15T20:00:00Z"}`.
devops-bot: deploy: routing-proxy canary emits fallback_reason (staging) - 2025-07-15 20:12 UTC
qa: test plan - synthetic clients which omit version header and ones with artificially long seqlen. assert `fallback_ttl_s` present, alert suppression works, and UI shows heatmap.
jana: thanks. once staging green, promote canary to 10% and monitor `fallback_thrash_rate`, `distinct_token_fallbacks`, and billing-alert-rate. file issues if we see leak to production tenants.
telemetry: noted. I'll add dashboards and a short-runbook snippet: "If fallback_thrash_rate>0.05 for >5m, pause flip and enable per-tenant cooldown."
ryan: also add console action: one-click "reset fallback markers for tenant" to clear hints if needed.
jana: perfect. keep this thread for roll-forward notes and final canary sign-off.
